title: Optical components mounted on a perforated breadboard
visual_facts: A large black rectangular optical breadboard with a regular grid of mounting holes sits on a light-colored table.
Several small optical elements are held by adjustable metal mounts across the board.
A laptop is open behind the board, with its screen dark.
A black electronic instrument with knobs and connected cables sits at the right.
A yellow-and-white labeled rectangular component is mounted near the right edge of the breadboard.
spatial_relations: The laptop is behind the breadboard.
The instrument is to the right of the breadboard and connected to the setup by cables.
Mounted optical elements are distributed across the breadboard surface.
uncertainties: Small labels on the equipment are too blurred to read, so the specific optical components and instrument models are uncertain.
